package probe

import "os/exec"

// other is a command this file did not build: rebinding a followed name to it
// leaves the name holding a command the check never saw. The rebinding itself
// is the finding, the run after it being no command the check can follow.
func rebindNonCommand(other *exec.Cmd) error {
	cmd := exec.Command("sh")
	cmd.Env = []string{"PATH=/usr/bin"}
	cmd = other
	return cmd.Run()
}
